title: Delivery Review
summary: Deliveries found in your inventory uploads: check the quantities, then confirm to log them as purchases.

blocks.text: Delivery Review finds deliveries by itself and lists them under **Suggested deliveries**, one per vendor and upload.

items: Most come from {pos}: when a delivery is received in {pos}, the next inventory upload carries the receive time and {pos}'s receiving number on each item.
On a day with no upload, a delivery shows as 3 or more of one vendor's items rising by more than sales explain.
The quantity is count now, minus count before, plus units sold in between. So 100 on hand, 400 delivered and 50 sold shows 400, not 350.
Open a suggestion and check each line against the invoice.
Change any quantity. A box turns red when it differs from the suggestion, as a reminder, not a block.
Select **Confirm & log**. It writes the purchase log, with each item's cost from that day's file.
A vendor whose delivery is already logged isn't suggested again.
**Not a delivery - dismiss** hides one. Undo brings it back.
You can also tick **We received a delivery today** on the inventory upload, then **Review delivery**.

blocks.text: Confirmed deliveries with a cost are what fill Vendor price comparison on Inventory Reports, and what make Reconciliation meaningful.
